description: This file defines a React functional component called 'ContentFilterManager' that manages content filtering settings, including patterns and blocked words. It handles loading data from props, managing local state, change detection for unsaved changes, and rendering either a display or editing interface for content filter configurations. It also exports a helper function to format patterns and blocked words for API submission.

methods.name: formatContentFilterDataForAPI
methods.description: Formats patterns and blocked words into the structure expected by an external API for content filter data submission.
